title: 番外 祝今也与周复之（二合一）
slug: 缺爱小可怜重回爸妈十八岁那年
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

周复之梦想中的大学生，是手里端着咖啡坐在树荫下悠哉的看着书，时而跟同伴讨论一下课业，浑身上下充满文化人气息的模样。

但现实中，周复之的大学生活是每天脸都不洗冲去教室抢位置，急头白脸的一顿学，又冲去食堂排窗口，急头白脸的一顿吃，又又冲去图书馆抢位置，急头白脸的一顿复习。

对他来说，每学期只有一个阶段：备战考试。

前半生学渣的周复之好不容易逆袭一回，来到大学发现自己居然还是吊车尾。

周复之一边学的想吐，一边幻想着自己未来当上科室主任被祝今也夸厉害的美好场景。

大一结束考试的那个暑假，周复之考完去找祝今也的第一件事就是抱着她痛哭一顿。

“太难了祝今也，太难了当医生怎么这么难比高考都难。”

“我不想努力了祝今也，我要吃软饭呜呜呜呜……”

抱着直往自己身上拱的周复之，祝今也感受着肩膀处的湿润，知道这家伙是真受苦了，这回不是假哭。

“可以。”

拍拍他的狗头，祝今也应允了他的软饭请求。

周复之哭的更厉害了。

他向来不委屈自己，尤其听到祝今也包容的声音，抓着她袖子一股脑儿诉说起来。

“我跟你说，我室友一点都不好，我把我爸腌的辣花萝卜分给他们，结果被他扔掉了，我在垃圾桶里看到了。”

“我自己都不舍得吃，既然不喜欢的话为什么还要收下。”

周复之当时蹲在垃圾桶跟前看了好久，一直犹豫要不要捡回来，最后还是没捡，萝卜跟垃圾混在一起，捡回来也没办法吃了。

听到这儿，祝今也眉头皱了一下：“当时怎么不告诉我？”

周复之沉默了一会儿。

他吸吸鼻子抬起头露出一双通红的眼睛：“我后来直接问他扔我萝卜是几个意思，他怂的不行立马跟我道歉了。”

说到这儿，周复之露出一个有些狡黠的笑：“他追的女生还跟我打听他人怎么样，我告诉那个女生他平时一双袜子能穿半个月，吃饭的时候吧唧嘴还扔了我的萝卜。”

女生当时听完下头的不行，回去就把他给拉黑了。

周复之得意洋洋的看着祝今也，眼神似乎在说：快表扬我啊~

祝今也十分违心的夸他真棒。

沉默一会儿，告诉他：“实在不喜欢，可以换个专业。”

周复之笑了一下，用脸颊蹭蹭她：“你现在都这么宠我了啊。”

“其实我就是说说，我还是想学医的，而且我跟小水母约定好了，等她出生发现我不是医生那可怎么解释。”

“而且，等小水母长大，跟别人介绍我的时候说“我爸爸是医生！”这多有面儿啊。”

身边人都是比他基础牢靠的学霸，这种落后于人的感觉让他每天都很焦虑，沉重的学习压力跟排满的课表，再加上他每天跟祝今也通电话的时间并不长，一个月见面次数也屈指可数，他晚上想祝今也想的躲在被窝里悄悄哭。

这两方夹击这让他备受煎熬。

“下学期应该会好很多吧。”

周复之唉声叹气。

祝今也很想提醒他，寒假的时候他也是这么说的。

“我室友虽然不行，但我们班同学都挺好的，他们都很喜欢我。”

这倒是正常，这小子经常仗着自己好看以及社牛属性在哪里都能混的开。

“光说我了，你也谈谈自己嘛，每次打电话你都是问我情况。”

“没什么好说的，除了学习就是工作。”

周复之撇撇嘴：“不是这些。”

他挽着祝今也的胳膊，细细给她讲：“比如食堂哪家的饭比较合你胃口啊，学校里哪棵树开花了、开的什么颜色，天气怎么样，湖边的黑天鹅有没有咬人，有没有小男生跟你搭讪。”

祝今也把他胳膊扒拉开，扭头看他：“你怎么知道我们学校有黑天鹅。”

周复之来他们学校次数不算多，祝今也从来没领他走过有湖的那条路。

看着他那滴溜溜转一看就心虚的小狗眼，祝今也捏着他的耳朵拽了拽：“最后一句才是重点吧。”

被捏住耳朵的周复之歪着脑袋可怜兮兮的看着她：“所以有没有嘛~”

“没有。”祝今也想也不想道。

周复之“哦”了一声，心里却想祝今也这个大骗子。

别以为他不知道当初新生入学的时候祝今也引起了多大的轰动，别说之前，就是现在也经常有隔壁学校的人借卡混进他们学校，为的就是偶遇祝今也。

是的，以上借卡混进去试图偶遇祝今也的人，也包括周复之。

Page (1/3)

The college student in Zhou Fuzhi's dream is someone who sits under the shade of a tree with a cup of coffee in his hand, reading a book leisurely, and occasionally discussing his homework with his peers. He looks like a cultured person.

But in reality, Zhou Fuzhi's college life consisted of rushing to the classroom every day to grab a seat, studying in a hurry, rushing to the cafeteria to line up at the window, eating in a hurry, rushing to the library to grab a seat, and reviewing in a hurry.

For him, there is only one stage in each semester: preparing for exams.

Zhou Fuzhi, who was a scumbag in the first half of his life, finally made a counterattack, and when he came to the university, he found that he was still the last one.

Zhou Fuzhi felt like vomiting while studying, while imagining the beautiful scene in which he would become the director of the department in the future and be praised by Zhu Jinye for his greatness.

During the summer vacation after his freshman year, the first thing Zhou Fuzhi did to find Zhu Jinye after the exam was to hold her and cry bitterly.

"It's too difficult, Zhu Jinye, it's too difficult. Why is it so difficult to be a doctor? It's even harder than the college entrance examination."

"I don't want to work hard anymore, Zhu Jinye, I want to eat soft rice, wuwuwuwu..."

Holding Zhou Fuzhi who was leaning against him, Zhu Jin also felt the moisture on his shoulders and knew that this guy was really suffering and was not pretending to cry this time.

"Okay."

After patting his dog's head, Zhu Jin agreed to his request.

Zhou Fuzhi cried even harder.

He never wronged himself, especially when he heard Zhu Jinye's tolerant voice, grabbing her sleeve and telling her story.

"Let me tell you, my roommates are not good at all. I gave them my dad's pickled spicy radish, but he threw it away. I saw it in the trash can."

"I'm not willing to eat it myself. Why would I accept it if I don't like it?"

Zhou Fuzhi squatted in front of the trash can and looked at it for a long time, always hesitating whether to pick it up or not. In the end, he didn't pick it up. The radish was mixed with the garbage and there was no way to eat it after he picked it up.

Hearing this, Zhu Jin also frowned: "Why didn't you tell me then?"

Zhou Fuzhi was silent for a while.

He sniffed and raised his head, revealing a pair of red eyes: "I later asked him directly what he meant by throwing the carrot at me, and he was so cowardly that he immediately apologized to me."

Having said this, Zhou Fuzhi showed a sly smile: "The girl he chased asked me how he was doing. I told the girl that he can usually wear a pair of socks for half a month. When he was eating, he even threw away my carrots."

After hearing what he said, the girl couldn't help it, so she blocked him when she got back.

Zhou Fuzhi looked at Zhu Jinye triumphantly, his eyes seemed to say: Praise me now~

Zhu Jin also praised him very much against his will.

After being silent for a while, I told him, "If you really don't like it, you can change your major."

Zhou Fuzhi smiled and rubbed his cheek against her: "You dote on me so much now."

"Actually, I just want to say that I still want to study medicine, and I have made an agreement with Little Jellyfish. How will she explain when she is born and finds out that I am not a doctor?"

"Moreover, when the little jellyfish grows up, when introducing me to others, he will say, "My dad is a doctor!""This is so honorable."

The people around him were all top academics who had a solid foundation than him. This feeling of falling behind made him anxious every day. The heavy study pressure and full class schedule, plus the short time he spent on the phone with Zhu Jinye every day, and the number of meetings in a month were only a handful. At night, he missed Zhu Jinye and hid in the bed and cried quietly.

The two parties were attacking him, which made him suffer.

"It should be much better next semester."

Zhou Fuzhi sighed.

Zhu Jin also wanted to remind him that he also said the same thing during the winter vacation.

"Although my roommate is not good, my classmates are pretty good and they all like me."

This is normal. This kid often relies on his good looks and social attributes to get through anywhere.

"Just talk about me, why don't you also talk about yourself? You always ask me about my situation every time I call."

“There’s nothing to say, except that study is work.”

Zhou Fuzhi curled his lips: "It's not these."

He held Zhu Jinye's arm and told her in detail: "For example, which cafeteria's food is more to your liking, which trees in the school are blooming and what color they are, what the weather is like, whether the black swans by the lake are biting, and whether any little boys are chatting with you."

Zhu Jin also pulled his arm away and turned to look at him: "How do you know there is a black swan in our school?"

Zhou Fuzhi didn't come to their school many times, and Zhu Jin never led him through the road with the lake.

Looking at his puppy eyes that made him feel guilty at first glance, Zhu Jin also pinched his ears and tugged: "The last sentence is the key point."

Zhou Fuzhi, whose ears were pinched, tilted his head and looked at her pitifully: "So, is there any~"

"No." Zhu Jin also said without thinking.

Zhou Fuzhi said "Oh", but in his heart he thought about Zhu Jinye, a big liar.

Don't think that he doesn't know how much of a sensation Zhu Jin caused when he was a freshman. Not to mention before, even now, people from the school next door often borrow cards to sneak into their school just to meet Zhu Jin by chance.

Yes, the above people who borrowed cards to sneak in and try to meet Zhu Jinye also included Zhou Fuzhi.
